CREATE TABLE misc( code INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL,  subcode INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL,  value BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (code, subcode))
CREATE TABLE groups( group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  recs_stamp INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  spec BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT "",  members BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT "")
CREATE TABLE tag_groups( group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  spec BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT "")
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE tag_members USING fts5(tag_ids, tokenize = "ascii", detail=none)
CREATE TABLE file_res (  refs_id INTEGER NOT NULL,    file_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT "",    file_type INTEGER NOT NULL,    file_pos INTEGER NOT NULL  )

CREATE TABLE ret_watch (refs_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, retwatch_status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, clean_doi TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE DEFAULT "", clean_pmid TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE DEFAULT "", clean_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, retwatch_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, retwatch_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT "", retwatch_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT "")
CREATE TABLE terms( list_id INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL,  term TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE ENCI_Base)

CREATE TABLE jterms( list_id INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL,  packed_term TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE ENCI_Base,  term  TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE ENCI_Base,  abbr1 TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE ENCI_Base DEFAULT "",  abbr2 TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE ENCI_Base DEFAULT "",  abbr3 TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE ENCI_Base DEFAULT "")
CREATE TABLE refs_ord(ro_trash_state INTEGER, ro_key_2 TEXT COLLATE ENCIN_ko_KR, ro_key_3 TEXT COLLATE ENCIN_ko_KR, ro_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE csort (  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,    mru_rank INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    sort_type INTEGER NOT NULL,    sort_spec TEXT NOT NULL,    sorted_order BLOB NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX refs_year_index ON refs (year)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fileres_refsidpathtype_index ON file_res ( refs_id, file_path, file_type)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fileres_refsidpos_index ON file_res (refs_id, file_pos)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fileres_path_index  ON file_res(file_path) WHERE file_type =  1 OR file_type =  4
CREATE INDEX retwatch_retwatchstatus_index ON ret_watch (retwatch_status)
CREATE INDEX retwatch_cleandoi_index ON ret_watch (clean_doi)
CREATE INDEX retwatch_cleanpmid_index ON ret_watch (clean_pmid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX terms_term_index on terms (list_id, term)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jterms_packedterm_index on jterms (list_id, packed_term)
CREATE INDEX jterms_term_index on jterms (list_id, term)
CREATE INDEX jterms_abbr1_index on jterms (list_id, abbr1)
CREATE INDEX jterms_abbr2_index on jterms (list_id, abbr2)
CREATE INDEX jterms_abbr3_index on jterms (list_id, abbr3)
CREATE INDEX refs_ord_keys_index ON refs_ord(ro_trash_state, ro_key_2, ro_key_3, ro_id)
CREATE TRIGGER refs__tag_members_AI AFTER INSERT ON refs BEGIN INSERT INTO tag_members  (rowid, tag_ids) VALUES (new.id, ' '); END
CREATE TRIGGER refs__tag_members_AD AFTER DELETE ON refs BEGIN DELETE FROM tag_members WHERE rowid = old.id; END
CREATE TRIGGER refs__ret_watch_AI AFTER INSERT ON refs BEGIN INSERT INTO ret_watch (refs_id) VALUES (new.id); END
CREATE TRIGGER refs__ret_watch_AD AFTER DELETE ON refs BEGIN DELETE FROM ret_watch WHERE refs_id = old.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER refs__ret_watch_AU AFTER UPDATE ON refs BEGIN UPDATE ret_watch SET retwatch_status = 0, clean_doi = "", clean_pmid = "", clean_version = 1, retwatch_id = 0, retwatch_reason = "", retwatch_url = "" WHERE (refs_id = new.id) AND (old.electronic_resource_number != new.electronic_resource_number OR old.accession_number != new.accession_number OR old.database_provider != new.database_provider OR ((old.url != new.url) AND ((0 = instr(old.url, 'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/')) != (0 = instr(new.url, 'ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/'))))); END

CREATE TRIGGER refs__refs_ord_AI  AFTER INSERT ON refs BEGIN INSERT INTO refs_ord (ro_trash_state, ro_key_2, ro_key_3, ro_id) VALUES (new.trash_state, EN_MAKE_SORT_KEY(new.author,2,12), EN_MAKE_SORT_KEY(new.year,3,12), new.id); END
CREATE TRIGGER refs__refs_ord_AD  AFTER DELETE ON refs BEGIN DELETE FROM refs_ord WHERE ro_id = old. id; END

CREATE TRIGGER refs__refs_ord_AU  AFTER UPDATE ON refs BEGIN DELETE FROM refs_ord WHERE ro_id = old. id;INSERT INTO refs_ord (ro_trash_state, ro_key_2, ro_key_3, ro_id) VALUES (new.trash_state, EN_MAKE_SORT_KEY(new.author,2,12), EN_MAKE_SORT_KEY(new.year,3,12), new.id); END
pdb_ddl: CREATE TABLE pdf_index (  pdfi_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,    version INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    refs_id INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    file_timestamp INTEGER UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    subkey BLOB NOT NULL,contents TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT "",tag TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ""  )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pdfindex_refsidsubkey_index ON pdf_index (refs_id, subkey)
